reviews.author: David Hildenbrand
reviews.summary: Identified the proposed pte_none_or_zero() function as 'horrible' and suggested simplifying the code by introducing additional helpers for checking zero-page mappings. Proposed a set of new helper functions to replace the existing logic.

2026-08-16.patch_summary: This RFC patch proposes adding a new function, pte_none_or_zero(), to the Linux kernel's memory management (mm) subsystem. The function is designed to determine whether a page table entry (PTE) maps nothing or the shared zero-page. This allows code that only cares about the contents of the PTE to treat both cases alike.
